title: Sketchbench quick tally (personal)
body:
Purpose: pocket-sized run tracker for small prompt/quantization experiments. Use for quick comparisons, jot notes, and decide whether to promote a config to formal benchmark.

Legend: p50/p95 latency in ms, tokens = output+input tokens (approx), cost_est = rough $/1000 tokens normalized. 'q' = quantization profile.

Table (CSV-style):
date,run_id,model,q,batch,seq_len,p50_ms,p95_ms,tokens,cost_est,notes,next_steps
2025-11-03,run-011,redwood-7b,8bit,4,512,48,120,320,0.012,fast but jitter at p95,probe batch=8
2025-11-05,run-013,redwood-7b,4bit,2,512,38,95,320,0.009,noticable artefacts on rare tokens, try mix-quant
2025-11-12,run-021,open-13b,8bit,1,1024,210,420,800,0.042,stable but costly; prefix cache helps drop p50 to 140
2025-12-01,run-034,redwood-4b,8bit,8,256,22,55,160,0.006,perfect for tiny endpoints; evaluate quality vs 7b
2025-12-18,run-048,redwood-7b,fp16,4,512,32,85,320,0.016,baseline fp16 perf; use as golden for quality
2026-01-13,run-062,redwood-7b,4bit,8,512,30,78,320,0.009,good mix of latency+cost, roll to canary?

Quick notes:
- Batch scaling: doubling batch from 4 to 8 reduces p50 by ~15-20% for 7b; watch tail latency spikes.
- 4bit q reduces cost ~40% vs fp16 but increases hallucination risk for factual prompts; need eval set.
- Prefix (KV) cache yields best ROI when sequence reuse >60% across requests.

Open questions / to-dos:
- Create small eval: 50 factual Q/A prompts to measure "fact flip" rate across quant profiles (assign by next week).
- Add p99 capture to nightly run; current runner only reports p95.
- Check memory fragmentation on 8bit runtime: sporadic OOM on burst; file issue if reproducible.

Short action plan:
- 2026-01-20: run eval sweep for 4bit vs 8bit on 7b (N = 500 prompts, record accuracy, BLEU-ish score).
- If accuracy drop <2% and cost drop >30% -> pursue 4bit for low-tier product.
- Otherwise, default to 8bit + cache for now.

References & quick links:
- Internal profiler PR: GH:rl-infer/profiler#452 (use for p99 hook)
- Jira epic for experiment tracking: JIRA:ENGINF-887
- Slack notes thread: #ml-bench (see message at ts=1678230000)

Notes to self: keep entries terse, copy into team sheet when promoting to formal benchmark, tag runs with dataset names next time (e.g., 'wiki-q50').

Scratch log (short):
- 2025-11-04: tried uniform batch=16 on 4b — p50 improved but p95 doubled; memory thrash.
- 2025-11-20: observed tokenization mismatch between local tokenizer and infra tokenizer; fix before eval.
- 2025-12-20: sample outputs show fewer repetitions in 4bit with entropy-weighted sampling; re-run with greedy to compare.
